title: Filter Inventory Days Remaining
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:reading
| search days_of_spares_remaining=*
| stats latest(days_of_spares_remaining) as days_of_spares_remaining latest(spares_count) as spares_count by filter_type
| sort 0 - days_of_spares_remaining
description: Ranks filter typess by filter inventory runway.
value: Days remaining on spare filters keeps maintenance from being blocked by an avoidable stockout.
implementation: Send filter inventory runway events to `index=personal` and keep `filter_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of filter inventory runway by filter types.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which filter typess stand out most for filter inventory runway.
